@pytest.mark.req("DATA-16")
def test_planted_exam_share_decreases_at_every_policy_level():
    """The generator's assessment weights give in_class_exams + oral_defense a strictly lower probability
    at each higher policy level, and process_logs + ai_critique a strictly higher one."""
    w = gen_module().ASSESSMENT_WEIGHTS
    exam = [w[p][1] + w[p][2] for p in range(5)]
    logs = [w[p][3] + w[p][4] for p in range(5)]
    assert all(a > b for a, b in zip(exam, exam[1:]))
    assert all(a < b for a, b in zip(logs, logs[1:]))

def test_generator_rejects_names_on_the_real_list(monkeypatch):
    """If a word-list combination is on the real list, the generator rejects it and draws again:
    with a real list containing every name seed 2026 would produce, none of them are used."""
    mod = gen_module()
    first = [r["name"] for r in mod.build(2026)["institutions"]]
    monkeypatch.setattr(mod, "load_real_names", lambda: first)
    second = [r["name"] for r in mod.build(2026)["institutions"]]
    assert not set(n.casefold() for n in second) & set(n.casefold() for n in first)

@pytest.mark.req("DATA-03")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("seed", SEEDS)
def test_statement_counts_and_fields(seed):
    """statements.csv has ~350 rows (within +-10%), 0-4 per institution, only the allowed pub_types,
    pub_dates from 2023-01 to 2026-10 as YYYY-MM, unique stmt_ids, and 2-5 sentences of text."""
    t = load(seed)
    rows = t["statements"]
    assert list(rows[0].keys()) == ["stmt_id", "inst_id", "pub_type", "pub_date", "text"]
    assert 315 <= len(rows) <= 385
    per_inst = Counter(r["inst_id"] for r in rows)
    assert max(per_inst.values()) <= 4
    assert len(per_inst) < len(t["institutions"]), "some institutions should have 0 statements"
    assert {r["pub_type"] for r in rows} == {"policy_page", "news", "strategic_plan",
                                             "syllabus_template", "faq"}
    assert all("2023-01" <= r["pub_date"] <= "2026-10" and len(r["pub_date"]) == 7 for r in rows)
    assert len({r["stmt_id"] for r in rows}) == len(rows)
    assert all(2 <= _sentences(r["text"]) <= 5 for r in rows)

@pytest.mark.req("INST-07")

def test_phase_from_first_req_prefix_and_kind_default(runfile):
    """phase comes from the first req ID's area (DATA -> P1, INST -> P0, TOK -> P6),
    not from .phase. With no req, phase is "untagged". kind defaults to unit."""
    data, tests = runfile
    assert (tests["test_pass"]["req_ids"], tests["test_pass"]["phase"]) == (["DATA-03"], "P1")
    assert (tests["test_fail"]["req_ids"], tests["test_fail"]["phase"]) == (["INST-01", "VAL-02"], "P0")
    assert tests["test_skip"]["phase"] == "P6"
    assert (tests["test_untagged"]["req_ids"], tests["test_untagged"]["phase"]) == ([], "untagged")
    assert tests["test_pass"]["kind"] == "property"
    assert tests["test_fail"]["kind"] == "unit"
    assert data["current_phase"] == "untagged"  # no .phase in the pytester project

@pytest.mark.req("INST-01")
@pytest.mark.kind("integration")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("event", EVENTS)
def test_registered_command_runs_from_path_with_spaces(tmp_path, event):
    """The exact command string from settings.json, run through a shell from a project dir
    whose path contains spaces (like the real one), reaches the hook and logs the event."""
    project = tmp_path / "proj with spaces"
    (project / ".claude" / "hooks").mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy(HOOK, project / ".claude" / "hooks" / "log_event.py")
    cmd = _commands(event)[0]["command"]
    env = {**os.environ, "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR": str(project)}
    stdin = json.dumps({"hook_event_name": event, "session_id": "s", "transcript_path": "",
                        "last_assistant_message": "x"})
    proc = subprocess.run(["/bin/sh", "-c", cmd], input=stdin, text=True,
                          capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=30)
    assert proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout == ""
    assert [e["event"] for e in events(project)] == [event]
